package_info.package_name: TeamViewer.exe / BetterShaders Setup 1.0.3.exe / Software.exe (malicious Electron apps)
package_info.why_malicious: These packages are Electron-based desktop applications distributed via NSIS installers that contain malicious Node.js code within their .asar archives. The code is designed to harvest sensitive user data (system info, browser histories, credentials) and exfiltrate it to external file-sharing services, masquerading as legitimate software to evade detection.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code collects system information, browser history, and credentials from the filesystem, then sends this data via HTTP POST to the gofile.io file-sharing service, resulting in exfiltration of sensitive user data.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Harvesting sensitive data and exfiltrating it to an external file-sharing service is a hallmark of infostealer malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate Electron apps should not access or transmit user credentials, browser history, or system information without explicit user consent.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate apps may collect crash logs or telemetry, but never credentials or browser history, and always with user consent.
key_indicators: Access to browser history and credentials files
Network requests to gofile.io or similar file-sharing services
Use of Node.js APIs for OS and filesystem access within an Electron app

attack_chain.action: User downloads and executes a trojanized Electron app distributed as an NSIS installer.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious Electron app is installed and launched.

attack_chain.action: Electron app unpacks and executes Node.js code from the .asar archive (a.js).
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code is loaded into memory.

attack_chain.action: Malicious Node.js code collects system information, browser history, and credentials.
attack_chain.leads_to: Sensitive data is gathered from the victim's machine.

attack_chain.action: Collected data is exfiltrated to gofile.io via HTTP POST.

behavioral_signatures: Electron app accessing browser history and credential files
Electron app making outbound HTTP POST requests to file-sharing services
Node.js code within .asar archives performing OS-level data collection
file_indicators: Presence of suspicious .asar files in Electron app resources
NSIS installer files with hashes: 9926e2782d603061b52d88f83d93e7af, cfc6e0014b3cc8d4dcaf0d76e2382556, b150afa6b3642ea1da1233b76f7b454e
network_indicators: Unusual HTTP POST requests from Electron app processes
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor Electron-based applications for unexpected access to sensitive files (browser history, credentials) and outbound network requests to file-sharing or data exfiltration services. Inspect .asar archives for Node.js scripts that perform data harvesting. Flag NSIS installers with known malicious hashes or those that unpack Electron apps with suspicious behaviors.
